hero.title: From model to agent
hero.meta: OpenAI · Bo Xu, Danny Zhang, Rohit Arunachalam · 2026-03-11
hero.en: The Responses API equips models with a computer environment so they can execute real workflows reliably, repeatably, and safely.
hero.zh: 从模型到 Agent 的关键跃迁，不是模型突然会执行任务，而是平台给模型配备了可编排、可执行、可持久化且可控的计算环境。

summary.lead: 正确结论：Responses API 的价值不只是新增 shell tool，而是把 shell、托管容器、文件系统、数据库、网络策略、skills 和 compaction 组合成生产级 Agent 工作流底座。

keyPoints.label: 核心判断
keyPoints.text: 单靠提示只能访问训练好的智能；计算环境让模型能操作文件、运行命令、调用 API 并生成持久产物。

keyPoints.label: 体系结构
keyPoints.text: Responses API 负责编排，shell 提供执行入口，container 提供状态与资源，skills 提供复用，compaction 支撑长任务。

keyPoints.label: 安全边界
keyPoints.text: 受控联网、allowlist、egress proxy 和域名级 secret 注入让能力扩展不等于无限制暴露。

cards.title: 问题不是命令行
cards.body: Agent 落地需要中间文件、长表格、联网、重试和上下文管理等工程底座。

cards.title: Shell 是执行入口
cards.body: 模型提出工具调用，平台在隔离环境执行，并把结果反馈回模型。

cards.title: Loop 由 API 编排
cards.body: Responses API 把模型上下文、工具执行、流式输出和后续推理串成闭环。

cards.title: Container 是工作现场
cards.body: 文件系统、SQLite 和网络策略让 Agent 能组织资源，而不是把一切塞进 prompt。

cards.title: Skills 降低重复摸索
cards.body: 重复流程被封装成可发现、可加载、可版本化的能力包。

cards.title: Compaction 支撑长程
cards.body: 上下文压缩保留关键状态，让长任务跨多轮持续运行。

sections.title: 从模型回答到 Agent 工作流

rows.en: By prompting models, you can only access trained intelligence.
rows.zh: 只靠提示模型，开发者只能调用模型训练出的智能。

rows.en: Giving the model a computer environment can achieve a much wider range of use cases.
rows.zh: 给模型配备计算机环境，才能扩展到运行服务、请求 API、生成表格或报告等更广泛场景。

rows.en: The practical problems include intermediate files, large tables, network access, timeouts, and retries.
rows.zh: 真实 Agent 会遇到中间文件、长表格、联网安全、超时和重试等工程问题。

rows.en: The model proposes steps and commands; the platform runs them in an isolated environment.
rows.zh: 模型提出步骤和命令，平台在隔离环境中执行它们。

rows.en: The environment includes a filesystem, optional structured storage like SQLite, and restricted network access.
rows.zh: 这个环境包含输入输出文件系统、SQLite 等可选结构化存储，以及受限网络访问。

rows.en: The goal is faster, more repeatable, and safer production workflows.
rows.zh: 目标是让生产工作流更快、更可重复、更安全。

sections.title: Shell 是执行入口，不是自治本身

rows.en: When we say using a tool, the model actually only proposes a tool call.
rows.zh: 所谓模型使用工具，实际上是模型提出工具调用。

rows.en: It cannot execute the call on its own.
rows.zh: 模型本身不能执行这个调用。

rows.en: The shell tool enables use cases beyond Python-only code interpreter, such as running Go or Java programs or starting a NodeJS server.
rows.zh: shell tool 比纯 Python code interpreter 覆盖更广，可运行 Go、Java 程序或启动 NodeJS 服务。

sections.title: 编排器把执行变成循环

rows.en: We need an orchestrator to get model output, invoke tools, and pass the tool response back to the model in a loop.
rows.zh: 需要编排器获取模型输出、调用工具，并把工具响应循环传回模型。

rows.en: The Responses API can orchestrate between the model and hosted tools out of the box.
rows.zh: Responses API 可以开箱即用地编排模型与托管工具。

rows.en: The loop repeats until the model returns a completion without additional shell commands.
rows.zh: 这个循环持续运行，直到模型返回不再包含 shell 命令的完成结果。

sections.title: 效率与上下文污染同时处理

rows.en: The model can propose multiple shell commands in one step.
rows.zh: 模型可以在一步中提出多个 shell 命令。

rows.en: The Responses API can execute them concurrently using separate container sessions.
rows.zh: Responses API 可以使用独立容器会话并发执行这些命令。

rows.en: Bounded output preserves the beginning and end while marking omitted content.
rows.zh: 有界输出保留头尾关键信息并标记省略部分，避免原始日志淹没上下文。

rows.en: Long-running tasks fill the context window.
rows.zh: 长时间运行的任务会填满上下文窗口。

rows.en: Compaction preserves key prior state in an encrypted token-efficient representation.
rows.zh: compaction 会以加密且 token 高效的表示保留关键历史状态。

rows.en: This allows workflows to continue coherently across context boundaries.
rows.zh: 这让多步、多工具的长流程可以跨上下文边界连贯继续。

sections.title: 文件系统让输入不必塞进 prompt

rows.en: The container is not only a place to run commands but also the working context for the model.
rows.zh: 容器不只是运行命令的地方，也是模型的工作上下文。

rows.en: A common anti-pattern is packing all input directly into prompt context.
rows.zh: 常见反模式是把所有输入直接塞进 prompt 上下文。

rows.en: A better pattern is to stage resources in the container file system.
rows.zh: 更好的方式是把资源组织在容器文件系统中，让模型按需打开、解析或转换。

sections.title: 结构化数据应该被查询，而不是整表粘贴

rows.en: Developers can store structured data in databases such as SQLite and query them.
rows.zh: 开发者可以把结构化数据存入 SQLite 等数据库并进行查询。

rows.en: Instead of copying an entire spreadsheet into the prompt, give the model a description of the tables.
rows.zh: 与其把整个电子表格复制进 prompt，不如给模型表结构说明。

rows.en: The model can query just the relevant rows, which is faster, cheaper, and more scalable.
rows.zh: 模型只查询相关行会更快、更便宜，也更适合大规模数据。

sections.title: 联网能力必须带策略层

rows.en: Agent workflows may need to fetch live data, call external APIs, or install packages.
rows.zh: Agent 工作流可能需要获取实时数据、调用外部 API 或安装包。

rows.en: Unrestricted internet access can expose information and increase credential leakage risk.
rows.zh: 无限制联网可能暴露信息，并增加凭证泄漏和数据外流风险。

rows.en: A sidecar egress proxy enforces allowlists and access controls while keeping traffic observable.
rows.zh: sidecar egress proxy 通过 allowlist 和访问控制管理出站流量，同时保持可观测。

sections.title: Skills 把重复流程封装成能力

rows.en: Many tasks repeat the same multi-step patterns.
rows.zh: 许多任务会重复相同的多步骤模式。

rows.en: Agent skills package those patterns into reusable, composable building blocks.
rows.zh: Agent skills 把这些模式打包成可复用、可组合的构件。

rows.en: A skill is a folder bundle with SKILL.md plus supporting resources.
rows.zh: 一个 skill 是包含 SKILL.md 和支持资源的文件夹包。

rows.en: The Responses API loads the skill and includes it in model context before sending the prompt.
rows.zh: 发送 prompt 前，Responses API 会加载 skill 并把它加入模型上下文。

rows.en: The sequence fetches metadata, fetches the bundle, copies it into the container, and updates model context.
rows.zh: 加载流程包括获取元数据、获取 bundle、复制进容器，并更新模型上下文。

rows.en: The model progressively explores instructions and runs scripts through shell commands.
rows.zh: 模型会逐步探索 skill 指令，并通过容器中的 shell 命令执行脚本。

sections.title: Agent 平台是多层能力组合

rows.en: The Responses API provides orchestration, the shell tool provides executable actions, and the hosted container provides persistent runtime context.
rows.zh: Responses API 提供编排，shell tool 提供可执行动作，托管容器提供持久运行时上下文。

rows.en: Skills layer reusable workflow logic, and compaction allows an agent to run for a long time with needed context.
rows.zh: skills 叠加可复用工作流逻辑，compaction 让 Agent 能带着所需上下文长时间运行。

rows.en: With these primitives, a single prompt can expand into an end-to-end workflow and durable artifacts.
rows.zh: 有了这些基础能力，一个 prompt 才能展开为端到端工作流并生成持久产物。

quiz.question: 这篇文章的核心论点是什么？
options: shell tool 本身让模型自动执行所有任务
Responses API 把执行、状态、安全、技能和压缩组合成 Agent 运行环境
只要有更大模型就能成为 Agent
数据库可以完全替代 prompt
quiz.explain: 文章结论把 Responses API、shell tool、hosted container、skills 和 compaction 组合为 Agent 运行底座。
quiz.wrongReason: 其他选项把单个能力误认为整体架构，或夸大了模型本身作用。

quiz.question: 模型使用 shell tool 时，谁真正执行命令？
options: 模型权重内部直接执行
平台在隔离容器环境中执行
quiz.explain: 原文说明模型只是提出工具调用，平台负责在计算环境中执行并返回结果。
quiz.wrongReason: 模型不会自行执行命令，浏览器和数据库也不是该执行路径。

quiz.question: 为什么需要 compaction？
options: 为了隐藏所有历史信息
为了在长任务中保留关键状态并减少冗余上下文
为了让 shell 输出无限制进入上下文
quiz.explain: 长任务会撑满上下文，compaction 用 token 高效的方式保留关键历史状态。
quiz.wrongReason: compaction 不是安全隐藏机制，也不是网络或日志系统的替代品。

quiz.question: 关于网络访问，文章强调的工程原则是什么？
options: 让容器拥有无限制互联网访问
通过策略层、allowlist、egress proxy 和域名级 secret 注入控制风险
quiz.explain: 原文强调受控出站代理、访问控制、可观测流量和域名级 secret 注入。
quiz.wrongReason: 无限制联网和直接暴露凭证正是文章要避免的风险。

rows.en:
Date: March 11, 2026
> Authors: Bo Xu, Danny Zhang, and Rohit Arunachalam

rows.zhHtml: 日期：2026 年 3 月 11 日 作者：Bo Xu、Danny Zhang 和 Rohit Arunachalam

rows.en: We're currently in a shift from using models, which excel at particular tasks, to using agents capable of handling complex workflows. By prompting models, you can only access trained intelligence. However, giving the model a computer environment can achieve a much wider range of use cases, like running services, requesting data from APIs, or generating more useful artifacts like spreadsheets or reports.
rows.zh: 我们目前正从使用擅长特定任务的模型，转向使用能够处理复杂工作流的 Agent。通过提示模型，你只能访问经过训练得到的智能。然而，给模型配备计算机环境，可以实现范围广得多的用例，例如运行服务、从 API 请求数据，或生成电子表格、报告等更有用的产物。
rows.html: We're currently in a shift from using models, which excel at particular tasks, to using agents capable of handling complex workflows. By prompting models, you can only access trained intelligence. However, giving the model a computer environment can achieve a much wider range of use cases, like running services, requesting data from APIs, or generating more useful artifacts like spreadsheets or reports.
rows.zhHtml: 我们目前正从使用擅长特定任务的模型，转向使用能够处理复杂工作流的 Agent。通过提示模型，你只能访问经过训练得到的智能。然而，给模型配备计算机环境，可以实现范围广得多的用例，例如运行服务、从 API 请求数据，或生成电子表格、报告等更有用的产物。

rows.en: A few practical problems emerge when you try to build agents: where to put intermediate files, how to avoid pasting large tables into a prompt, how to give the workflow network access without creating a security headache, and how to handle timeouts and retries without building a workflow system yourself.
rows.zh: 当你尝试构建 Agent 时，会出现一些实际问题：中间文件放在哪里，如何避免把大型表格粘贴进提示词，如何在不给安全带来麻烦的情况下让工作流访问网络，以及如何在不自己构建工作流系统的情况下处理超时和重试。

rows.en: Instead of putting it on developers to build their own execution environments, we built the necessary components to equip the [Responses API](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/migrate-to-responses) with a computer environment to reliably execute real-world tasks.
rows.zh: 我们没有把构建执行环境的责任交给开发者，而是构建了必要组件，为 Responses API 配备计算机环境，以可靠地执行真实世界任务。

rows.en: In this post, we'll break down how we built a computer environment for agents and share some early lessons on how to use it for faster, more repeatable, and safer production workflows.
rows.zh: 在这篇文章中，我们会拆解我们如何为 Agent 构建计算机环境，并分享一些早期经验，说明如何用它构建更快、更可重复、更安全的生产工作流。

rows.en: A good agent workflow starts with a tight execution loop: the model proposes an action like reading files or fetching data with API, the platform runs it, and the result feeds into the next step. We'll start with the shell tool - the simplest way to see this loop in action - and then cover the container workspace, networking, reusable skills, and context compaction.
rows.zh: 一个好的 Agent 工作流始于紧密的执行循环：模型提出一个动作，例如读取文件或通过 API 获取数据；平台运行该动作；结果再进入下一步。我们将从 shell tool 开始，这是观察这个循环实际运行的最简单方式；随后会介绍容器工作区、网络、可复用 skills 和上下文压缩。

rows.en: To understand the shell tool, it's first useful to understand how a language model uses tools in general: to do things like call a function or interact with a computer. During training, a model is shown examples of how tools are used and the resulting effects, step by step. This helps the model learn to decide when to use a tool and how to use it. When we say "using a tool", we mean the model actually only proposes a tool call. It can't execute the call on its own.
rows.zh: 要理解 shell tool，首先有必要理解语言模型通常如何使用工具：例如调用函数或与计算机交互。在训练过程中，模型会逐步看到工具如何被使用以及由此产生的效果。这有助于模型学会判断何时使用工具以及如何使用工具。当我们说“使用工具”时，实际意思是模型只提出一个工具调用。它不能自行执行这个调用。

rows.alt: The shell tool is just another tool: a diagram showing the model proposing a shell tool call and the platform executing it in a computer environment.

rows.en: The shell tool makes the model dramatically more powerful: it interacts with a computer through the command line to carry out a wide range of tasks, from searching for text to sending API requests on your computer. Built on familiar Unix tooling, our shell tool can do anything you'd expect, with utilities like `grep`, `curl`, and `awk` available out of the box.

rows.en: Compared to our existing code interpreter, which only executes Python, the shell tool enables a much wider range of use cases, like running Go or Java programs or starting a NodeJS server. This flexibility lets the model fulfill complex agentic tasks.

rows.en: The Responses API is how developers interact with OpenAI models. When used with custom tools, the Responses API yields control back to the client, and the client requires its own harness for running the tools. However, this API can also orchestrate between the model and hosted tools out of the box.
rows.zh: Responses API 是开发者与 OpenAI 模型交互的方式。与自定义工具一起使用时，Responses API 会把控制权交还给客户端，客户端需要自己的运行框架来执行这些工具。不过，这个 API 也可以开箱即用地在模型和托管工具之间进行编排。

rows.alt: Agent loop diagram: Responses API orchestrates model and shell execution in a hosted container.

rows.en: When the Responses API receives a prompt, it assembles model context: user prompt, prior conversation state, and tool instructions. For shell execution to work, the prompt must mention using the shell tool *and* the selected model must be trained to propose shell commands - models GPT-5.2 and later are trained for this. With all of this context, the model then decides the next action. If it chooses shell execution, it returns one or more shell commands to Responses API service. The API service forwards those commands to the container runtime, streams back shell output, and feeds it to the model in the next request's context. The model can then inspect the results, issue follow-up commands, or produce a final answer. The Responses API repeats this loop until the model returns a completion without additional shell commands.
rows.zh: 当 Responses API 收到提示词时，它会组装模型上下文：用户提示词、之前的对话状态和工具指令。要让 shell 执行生效，提示词必须提到使用 shell tool，并且所选模型必须经过训练，能够提出 shell 命令。GPT-5.2 及之后的模型接受过这方面训练。具备这些上下文后，模型会决定下一步动作。如果它选择 shell 执行，就会向 Responses API 服务返回一个或多个 shell 命令。API 服务把这些命令转发给容器运行时，流式返回 shell 输出，并把输出放入下一次请求的上下文中交给模型。随后模型可以检查结果、发出后续命令，或生成最终答案。Responses API 会重复这个循环，直到模型返回不包含额外 shell 命令的完成结果。

rows.en: When the Responses API executes a shell command, it maintains a streaming connection to the container service. As output is produced, the API relays it to the model in near real time so the model can decide whether to wait for more output, run another command, or move on to a final response.
rows.zh: 当 Responses API 执行 shell 命令时，它会与容器服务保持流式连接。随着输出产生，API 会近实时地把输出转发给模型，让模型判断是等待更多输出、运行另一条命令，还是进入最终响应。

rows.en: The Responses API streams shell command output
rows.zh: Responses API 会流式传输 shell 命令输出
rows.html: The Responses API streams shell command output

rows.en: The model can propose multiple shell commands in one step, and the Responses API can execute them concurrently using separate container sessions. Each session streams output independently, and the API multiplexes those streams back into structured tool outputs as context. In other words, the agent loop can parallelize work, such as searching files, fetching data, and validating intermediate results.
rows.zh: 模型可以在一步中提出多个 shell 命令，Responses API 可以使用独立的容器会话并发执行它们。每个会话独立地流式输出，API 会将这些流复用回结构化工具输出，并作为上下文提供。换句话说，Agent 循环可以并行化工作，例如搜索文件、获取数据和验证中间结果。

rows.alt: Responses API multiplexes command execution sessions.

rows.en:
When the command involves file operations or data processing, shell output can become very large and consume context budgets without adding useful signals. To control this, the model specifies an output cap per command. The Responses API enforces that cap and returns a bounded result that preserves both the beginning and end of the output, while marking omitted content. For example, you might bound the output to 1,000 characters, with preserved beginning and end:

text at the beginning ... 1000 chars truncated ... text at the end
rows.zh:
当命令涉及文件操作或数据处理时，shell 输出可能变得非常大，消耗上下文预算却不增加有用信号。为控制这一点，模型会为每条命令指定输出上限。Responses API 会执行该上限，并返回一个有界结果，保留输出的开头和结尾，同时标记被省略的内容。例如，你可以把输出限制为 1,000 个字符，并保留开头和结尾：

开头的文本 ... 已截断 1000 个字符 ... 结尾的文本

groups.group: When the context window gets full: compaction

rows.en: One potential issue with agent loops is that tasks can run for a long time. Long-running tasks fill the context window, which is important for providing context across turns and across agents. Picture an agent calling a skill, getting a response, adding tool calls and reasoning summaries - the limited context window quickly fills up. To avoid losing the important context as the agent continues running, we need a way to keep the key details and remove anything extraneous. Instead of requiring developers to design and maintain custom summarization or state-carrying systems, we added native compaction in the Responses API, designed to align with how the model behaves and how it's been trained.
rows.zh: Agent 循环的一个潜在问题是任务可能运行很长时间。长时间运行的任务会填满上下文窗口，而上下文窗口对于跨轮次和跨 Agent 提供上下文很重要。想象一个 Agent 调用 skill、获得响应、添加工具调用和推理摘要，有限的上下文窗口很快就会被填满。为了在 Agent 持续运行时不丢失重要上下文，我们需要一种方式保留关键细节并移除多余内容。我们没有要求开发者设计和维护自定义的摘要或状态携带系统，而是在 Responses API 中加入了原生 compaction，其设计与模型行为和训练方式保持一致。

rows.en: Our latest models are trained to analyze prior conversation state and produce a compaction item that preserves key prior state in an encrypted token-efficient representation. After compaction, the next context window consists of this compaction item and high-value portions of the earlier window. This allows workflows to continue coherently across window boundaries, even in extended multi-step and tool-driven sessions. [Codex relies on this mechanism](https://openai.com/index/unrolling-the-codex-agent-loop/) to sustain long-running coding tasks and iterative tool execution without degrading quality.
rows.zh: 我们的最新模型经过训练，能够分析先前的对话状态，并生成一个 compaction 项，以加密且 token 高效的表示保留关键的先前状态。compaction 之后，下一个上下文窗口由这个 compaction 项和早期窗口中的高价值部分组成。这让工作流能够跨窗口边界连贯地继续，即使是在较长的多步骤、工具驱动会话中也是如此。Codex 依赖这一机制来维持长时间运行的编码任务和迭代式工具执行，同时不降低质量。

rows.en: Compaction is available either built-in on the server or through a standalone `/compact` endpoint. Server-side compaction lets you configure a threshold, and the system handles compaction timing automatically, eliminating the need for complex client-side logic. It allows a slightly larger effective input context window to tolerate small overages right before compaction, so requests near the limit can still be processed and compacted rather than rejected. As model training evolves, the native compaction solution evolves with it for every OpenAI model release.
rows.zh: Compaction 可以作为服务器内置能力使用，也可以通过独立的 /compact 端点使用。服务端 compaction 允许你配置阈值，系统会自动处理 compaction 时机，从而不需要复杂的客户端逻辑。它允许稍大的有效输入上下文窗口，以容忍 compaction 前的少量超限，因此接近限制的请求仍可以被处理和压缩，而不是被拒绝。随着模型训练演进，原生 compaction 方案也会随每个 OpenAI 模型版本一起演进。

rows.en: Codex helped us build the compaction system while serving as an early user of it. When one Codex instance hit a compaction error, we'd spin up a second instance to investigate. The result was that Codex got a native, effective compaction system just by working on the problem. This ability for Codex to inspect and refine itself has become an especially interesting part of working at OpenAI. Most tools only require the user to learn how to use them; Codex learns alongside us.

rows.en: Now let's cover state and resources. The container is not only a place to run commands but also the working context for the model. Inside the container, the model can read files, query databases, and access external systems under network policy controls.

rows.alt: Inside the runtime container: files, databases, skills, and a policy-controlled network.

rows.en: The first part of container context is the file system for uploading, organizing, and managing resources. We built [container and file](https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/containers) APIs to give the model a map of available data and help it choose targeted file operations instead of performing broad, noisy scans.
rows.zh: 容器上下文的第一部分是文件系统，用于上传、组织和管理资源。我们构建了容器和文件 API，为模型提供可用数据的映射，并帮助它选择有针对性的文件操作，而不是执行范围很广、噪声很大的扫描。

rows.en: A common anti-pattern is packing all input directly into prompt context. As inputs grow, overfilling the prompt becomes expensive and hard for the model to navigate. A better pattern is to stage resources in the container file system and let the model decide what to open, parse, or transform with shell commands. Much like humans, models work better with organized information.

rows.en: The second part of container context is databases. In many cases, we suggest developers store structured data in databases as SQLite and query them. Instead of copying an entire spreadsheet into the prompt, for example, you can give the model a description of the tables - what columns exist and what they mean - and let it pull the rows it needs.

rows.en: For example, if you ask, "Which products had declining sales this quarter?" the model can query *just* the relevant rows instead of scanning the whole spreadsheet. This is faster, cheaper, more scalable to larger datasets.

rows.en: The third part of the container context is network access, an essential part of agent workloads. Agent workflow may need to fetch live data, call external APIs, or install packages. At the same time, giving containers unrestricted internet access can be risky: it can expose information to external websites, unintentionally touch sensitive internal or third-party systems, or make credential leaks and data exfiltration harder to guard against.
rows.zh: 容器上下文的第三部分是网络访问，这是 Agent 工作负载的重要组成部分。Agent 工作流可能需要获取实时数据、调用外部 API 或安装包。同时，给容器不受限制的互联网访问可能有风险：它可能把信息暴露给外部网站，无意中触碰敏感的内部或第三方系统，或让凭证泄漏和数据外泄更难防范。

rows.en: To address these concerns without limiting agents' usefulness, we built hosted containers to use a sidecar egress proxy. All outbound network requests flow through a centralized policy layer that enforces allowlists and access controls while keeping traffic observable. For credentials, we use domain-scoped secret injection at egress. The model and container only see placeholders, while raw secret values stay outside model-visible context and only get applied for approved destinations. This reduces the risk of leakage while still enabling authenticated external calls.
rows.zh: 为了解决这些担忧，同时不限制 Agent 的实用性，我们让托管容器使用 sidecar 出站代理。所有出站网络请求都会经过集中式策略层，该策略层执行 allowlist 和访问控制，同时保持流量可观测。对于凭证，我们在出站处使用按域名限定的 secret 注入。模型和容器只能看到占位符，原始 secret 值保留在模型可见上下文之外，并且只会用于获批的目标。这降低了泄漏风险，同时仍支持经过身份验证的外部调用。

rows.en: Shell commands are powerful, but many tasks repeat the same multi-step patterns. Agents have to rediscover the workflow each run - replanning, reissuing commands, and relearning conventions - leading to inconsistent results and wasted execution. [Agent skills](https://agentskills.io/home) package those patterns into reusable, composable building blocks. Concretely, a skill is a folder bundle that includes `SKILL.md` containing metadata and instructions plus any supporting resources, such as API specs and UI assets.
rows.zh: Shell 命令很强大，但许多任务会重复相同的多步骤模式。Agent 每次运行都必须重新发现工作流，重新规划、重新发出命令、重新学习约定，导致结果不一致和执行浪费。Agent skills 将这些模式打包成可复用、可组合的构建块。具体来说，一个 skill 是一个文件夹包，其中包含带有元数据和指令的 SKILL.md，以及 API 规格和 UI 资产等任何支持资源。

rows.en: This structure maps naturally to the runtime architecture we described earlier. The container provides persistent files and execution context, and the shell tool provides the execution interface. With both in place, the model can discover skill files using shell commands (`ls`, `cat`, etc.) when it needs to, interpret instructions, and run skill scripts all in the same agent loop.
rows.zh: 这种结构自然映射到我们前面描述的运行时架构。容器提供持久文件和执行上下文，shell tool 提供执行接口。两者就位后，模型可以在需要时使用 shell 命令（ls、cat 等）发现 skill 文件、解释指令，并在同一个 Agent 循环中运行 skill 脚本。

rows.en:
We provide [APIs](https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/skills) to manage skills in the OpenAI platform. Developers upload and store skill folders as versioned bundles, which can later be retrieved by skill ID. Before sending the prompt to the model, the Responses API loads the skill and includes it in model context. This sequence is deterministic:

1. Fetch skill metadata, including name and description.
2. Fetch the skill bundle, copy it into the container, and unpack it.
3. Update model context with skill metadata and the container path.
rows.zh:
我们在 OpenAI 平台中提供用于管理 skills 的 API。开发者上传并存储 skill 文件夹作为带版本的 bundle，之后可以通过 skill ID 检索。在把提示词发送给模型之前，Responses API 会加载该 skill，并把它包含在模型上下文中。这个序列是确定性的：

获取 skill 元数据，包括名称和描述。获取 skill bundle，将其复制到容器中并解包。用 skill 元数据和容器路径更新模型上下文。

rows.en: When deciding whether a skill is relevant, the model progressively explores its instructions, and executes its scripts through shell commands in the container.
rows.zh: 在判断某个 skill 是否相关时，模型会逐步探索其指令，并通过容器中的 shell 命令执行其脚本。

rows.en: To put all the pieces together: the *Responses API* provides orchestration, the *shell tool* provides executable actions, the *hosted container* provides persistent runtime context, *skills* layer reusable workflow logic, and *compaction* allows an agent to run for a long time with the context it needs.
rows.zh: 把所有部分合在一起看：Responses API 提供编排，shell tool 提供可执行动作，托管容器提供持久运行时上下文，skills 叠加可复用的工作流逻辑，而 compaction 让 Agent 能够带着所需上下文长时间运行。
